question: The tissue that will become the scrotum in a male becomes the labia in a female, thus, they are regarded as having what relationship? (A) mutual (B) opposite (C) homologous (D) symbiotic
What is the term for the force that a magnet exerts on certain materials? (A) gravitational force (B) magnetic force (C) positive force (D) potential force
What term is used to describe the development of new technology? (A) industrial design (B) technological design (C) mechanical engineering (D) technological expansion
Temperature, water, soil, and air are examples of nonliving factors of an ecosystem, also termed what? (A) conditional factors (B) nucleic factors (C) abiotic factors (D) diverse factors
The sternocleidomastoid is the major muscle that laterally flexes and rotates what? (A) eye (B) tongue (C) head (D) knee

Competition that occurs between members of the same species, which improves the species’ adaptations, is called what? (A) intraspecific competition (B) adaptive behavior (C) commensalism (D) interspecies competition
What arises due to crossing over, independent assortment, and the random union of gametes? (A) genetic variation (B) susceptible variation (C) alternative variation (D) recessive variation

Myofibrils are long cylindrical structures that lie parallel to and run the entire length of what fibers? (A) heart muscle fibers (B) skeletal muscle fibers (C) luminous muscle fibers (D) uplift muscle fibers
What structures are at the end of the long air passages in the lungs? (A) alveoli (B) Oral Cavity (C) chloride (D) Larynx
Can nematodes be a parasite of plants, animals, or both? (A) neither (B) plants (C) animals (D) both
What part of the sperm contains the nucleus? (A) nucleus (B) body (C) head (D) tail
If a substance has a ph value greater than 7, what does it indicate? (A) base (B) acidic (C) volatile (D) neutral
Assume a molecule must cross the plasma membrane into what? (A) shell (B) atom (C) circle (D) cell
Water found on the surface of the earth is referred to as what? (A) surface water (B) groundwater (C) reservoir water (D) runoff

What is the phenotypic range of a particular genotype called? (A) norm of reaction (B) range of motion (C) diversity (D) natural selection

Unlike matter, which is continuously recycled through ecosystems, what must constantly be added to an ecosystem for use by organisms? (A) fuel (B) hydrogen (C) carbon (D) energy
What process done by bacteria makes them important producers in aquatic ecosystems? (A) infection (B) reproduction (C) maturation (D) photosynthesis

Which planet is named after the roman goddess of love? (A) Neptune (B) venus (C) Mercury (D) Jupiter
A bee will sometimes do a dance to tell other bees in the hive where to find what? (A) water (B) enemies (C) food (D) honey
What is the difference between oils and fats at room temperature? (A) liquid and gas states (B) saturated and unsaturated (C) liquid and solid states (D) solid and gas states

Chitin, also found in the exoskeleton of insects, gives structural strength to the cell walls of fungi. the cell wall protects the cell from what? (A) entrainment and predators (B) starvation and predators (C) fermentation and predators (D) desiccation and predators
